purpose: Give players, parents, educators, creators and press useful ways to discover Mythical Void without waiting for social accounts or paid promotion.

authority.source: Kevin's active company-building goal and explicit autonomy for in-scope decisions

pages.audience: People encountering Mythical Void for the first time, including players, families, creators, press and educators
pages.intent: Choose the feeling wanted from a new game, understand the playable journey and enter without guessing what is real

pages.audience: Players and families who want a simple shared reason to begin the game without needing multiplayer or an account
pages.intent: Invite one known person, hatch separately and compare the creature-engine ingredients honestly

pages.audience: Players, creature-game fans, creators and game developers
pages.intent: Understand the varied creature genetics and the boundary between the playable form and wider artwork

pages.audience: Families, educators, STEM communities, creators and press
pages.intent: Understand how selected public NASA material can support optional discovery inside a fictional world

pages.audience: Parents, guardians and adults evaluating a younger player's first use
pages.intent: Understand cost, access, saves, fantasy combat, privacy and AI boundaries before play

pages.audience: Players, families, press, creators, partners and game-development peers
pages.intent: Understand the father-and-son origin and how a small human-led studio uses generative AI tools

releaseChecks: unique title, description, heading and canonical URL
crawlable body copy with a useful purpose independent of ranking
direct play link and internal links between useful pages
generated artwork and real gameplay labelled separately
NASA source, credit boundary and non-endorsement statement
analytics off until the visitor chooses to allow it
all routes present in the sitemap
